what: blaze build turns [workspace.metadata.blaze.lints] into --warn=blaze::<lint> flags for the compile (blaze-units flags.rs:229), but the compile registry (blaze-lint-defs blaze_lints(), 1 lint) does not know blaze-lints lints, so each one gets warning[E0602] unknown lint and is never run (self-run-1101-073755PST.log:40-62). Two fixes: (1) a blaze:: lint the user asked for that blaze does not know is an error naming it and where it was set, not a warning (no-fallback; the blaze tool is ours, so this is no rustc divergence). (2) one table of blaze:: lints: blaze-lints blaze::Lint::ALL and blaze-lint-defs must agree (generate one from the other, or have the build hand blaze-lints levels only to `blaze clippy`, never as compile flags). Please route to the blaze-lint-defs / diagnostics levels owner; tests-misc-lints owns the blaze-lints side.
